preregistration.selection: All twelve predetermined images remain included. No OCR, extracted text or application-parser result was observed before this freeze. No failed case is removed, replaced, relabelled or pooled with v1.
preregistration.population: Ten new printed Swedish SEK supplier invoices with 25% VAT, five normal sans/serif families, ten natural inline/stacked/two-column arrangements, 1600x2000 pixels and 28-36px normal field/body text. Two separately labelled damaged images retain their source gold. A purposive sample, not population-representative data.
preregistration.metadata: direction=supplier and direction_confident=true are supplied context. No direction-recognition claim may be drawn from these images. Report mandatory image-derived nine fields separately.
preregistration.acceptance: For EACH parser, both all-13 and mandatory-10 normal scopes require precision >=98% and recall >=85%, with no processing errors. Also require zero critical false-green decisions and safe non-green abstention on BOTH stress images. No cross-parser or cross-population averaging.
preregistration.stressAcceptance: Keep original complete gold; absent source values count as FN. Stress never improves normal-population precision/recall or replaces a readable input.
preregistration.freezeRule: Commit literal gold, specification, visually inspected exact PNGs, generator, measurement code, metric definitions and thresholds before any OCR. Bind and commit the later delivered implementation SHA before first execution. Retain the first complete result and any infrastructure interruption transparently; no output-dependent tuning.

methodology.opticalChain: One real runDocumentProcess(bytes, image/png) call per frozen raster, from the exact selected source. Its original text, actual confidence and hash-bound word evidence are passed once to the actual Node parser and once to the actual Sites parser. No confidence override, OCR-text editing or gold-dependent input preprocessing.
methodology.sitesScope: The actual Sites field parser consumes the same Node-worker optical output. This measures Sites field interpretation after the existing worker, not browser Tesseract, cloud transport, upload, registration or payment approval.
methodology.scalarPrecision: TP/(TP+FP); an incorrect non-null value counts as both FP and FN. Null output for a known source value counts as FN. Exact string and integer minor-unit comparison uses the unchanged existing metric helper.
methodology.scalarRecall: TP/(TP+FN), independently for all 13 fields, mandatory 10 and mandatory 9 excluding the supplied direction metadata.
methodology.documentExactness: Every field in the corresponding scope must equal gold, and processing must not have failed. No case is omitted from its fixed population.
methodology.falseGreen: The existing strict false-green rubric applies to all 13 fields. Critical false-green is also counted explicitly when green occurs with processing failure, required review, stress input or a wrong/missing critical field.
methodology.independence: New specifications, separate literal gold, frozen raster bytes and preregistered measurement code were committed before the first OCR call. No observed holdout output was used for source, threshold, corpus or answer changes.
methodology.timing: One cold child OCR worker per input; its measured processing time is shared by the two parser evaluations. Parser durations are measured separately. Per-engine times must not be summed to estimate wall time.

limitations: Small purposive synthetic sample; ten readable layouts do not establish population precision at 98% with statistical confidence or represent all customer invoices.
Single-page printed Swedish SEK supplier invoices with 25% VAT and explicit labels. No handwriting, arbitrary multi-page documents, other currencies/languages or real customer originals.
Direction is supplied trusted context, not visually recognized. Required image-derived fields are additionally reported without direction.
Both engines share one optical result for each raster. The 20 normal parser evaluations are not 20 independent images.
OCR documents remain under the product manual-review policy. Zero false-green results alone does not demonstrate usable automatic economic approval.
Stress image gold retains the uncorrupted source facts. Safe abstention lowers stress recall; stress is never pooled into or substituted for the readable acceptance population.

All src/ and sites/lib/ hashes are retained to detect later relevant changes. Only the worker and field parsers are executed here; downstream economy/domain/presentation hashes are contextual provenance, not functional acceptance of those services.
No live bank, Gmail, production data, paid OCR service, network OCR model download or new dependency is used. Installed local Swedish trained data are hashed.
Measured time depends on this shared host, its load and installed native dependencies; no production latency guarantee is inferred.
